message: So there I was, happily cooking dinner and trying to keep an eye on my phone for a timer. Just when I thought I had everything under control, my phone decided it was the perfect time to die! 😅 Talk about a wake-up call to double-check my smoke alarms and have a backup plan for kitchen safety. Lesson learned: maybe I should stick a good old-fashioned kitchen timer on the wall! What do you do to keep things safe in the chaos of cooking?
